d: The Network Account Manager is responsible for maximizing the performance and effectiveness of the Network Account Management team through strategic planning, insight generation, deployment optimization, performance governance and capability building. The role shapes the NAM operating model, enables consistent execution across assigned markets and coordinates cross-functional priorities to strengthen patient impact and business outcomes within approved governance
q: Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Medicine, Life Sciences, Business, or related field.
5 years’ pharmaceutical/healthcare commercial experience, including strategic or network account management.
Vaccine Therapeutic Area and Kuwait / Qatar market experience are preferred.
Strong knowledge of healthcare systems, go-to-market models, business planning, and analytics.
Strong cross-functional leadership, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
Fluency in English; Arabic is an advantage.
Demonstrable capabilities to manage or work withing a matrix organization.
Strong interpersonal skills with in-depth understanding of customer management – motivation, needs and building partnerships.
Demonstrated team player/dedicated to supporting a team culture that values, recognizes and generates high performance, supports innovation and challenges the status quo.
Must be able to demonstrate competence in influencing a broad range of stakeholders through credible, clear, and logical communication.
Thorough understanding of how to develop and use customer insights proactively.
Commercially astute with strong business acumen with ability to identify and capture sales opportunities.
Comfortable with risk taking and risk management.
Ability to make strategic decisions and propose innovative solutions.
Strong Problem Solving and Stakeholder management skills.
Strong Negotiation skills – internal and external – ability to exercise informal influence.
Change agile and resilient with a growth mindset paradigm.
Strong collaborator within and outside the Gulf Cluster.

Internal: Gulf and Middle East Commercial leadership; NAM colleagues; Marketing; Medical; Access & Value; Tenders; Supply Chain; Finance; Legal; Compliance; Digital; Customer Analytics and Insights; PX; and other relevant market and cluster teams.
External: Approved providers, partners or stakeholders engaged to support NAM capability, analytics or operating-model initiatives, as required and within established governance.

Accountable for NAM strategy, team effectiveness, deployment, performance governance and capability building. The role enables the NAM team and does not replace day-to-day account ownership assigned to customer-facing roles.

Translate business, market and customer insights into clear NAM priorities, team plans and scalable ways of working across assigned markets.
Identify strategic opportunities and execution gaps and mobilize cross-functional partners to develop practical solutions.
Define and maintain the NAM performance framework, scorecards, metrics and review cadence.
Lead regular business reviews to assess progress, identify gaps and agree corrective actions.
Share actionable performance insights and escalate material execution risks through appropriate governance.
